translations.en: "Same-day delivery anywhere in the labyrinth, as soon as you order!"
That's my delivery service.
But the jobs just weren't coming in.
I was starting to wonder
if the whole business had been a mistake.
Then today, a request came in! Yesss!
Or so I thought, until I heard it involved @6rGraham Rootze@0r.
I have to deliver supplies to someone stranded in the middle levels.
Here's what the client was like.
"My friend has become stranded in @6rGraham Rootze@0r, you see. Ahem.
Much as it pains me, I require you to deliver some healing items."
Talk about putting on airs!
But they're my first customer. I can't afford to lose them!
Still, I can't tackle @6rGraham Rootze@0r on my own.
So, help a frail young maiden out,
and come along as my porter and bodyguard?
You almost ask what part of her is a frail young maiden,
but decide to keep that thought to yourself.
Now, what should you do about this request?
You received @3rEin Reflect@0r.
@7rBeatrix@0r! Take a look at this!
If the legends are right, it should ward off demons.
Perhaps because of its supposed power to repel demons and @7rCyrus's@0r earnestness,
@7rBeatrix@0r examines it even more carefully than usual.
Yes, this is a demon-repelling staff...
Demons hate this scent.
Really?! Then we can use it to...
However, its power has already... worn off.
Huh...
I can assure you, its power is gone.
It probably ran out about fifty years ago.
No... I thought I'd finally made myself useful...
Is that what you've been worrying about?
Whether you're useful or not, you're one of us, aren't you?
@7rCarmine@0r...
Yes. I consider you one of us too.
You did your best for the townspeople and for us, didn't you?
That's enough.
I-I didn't... Oh, right. I haven't given you your reward.
Please accept this as my thanks!
From @7rCyrus@0r, you received @3rEin Reflect@0r as a reward.
It looks like we wasted our time, but thank you.
Next time, I'll try to find something that won't be a waste of effort.
@7rCyrus@0r calls it a wasted effort, but this incident seems to have mended things between @7rCyrus@0r and
@7rBeatrix@0r and the others.
For that alone, perhaps the adventure was not wasted.
I'm ready to go.
Come on, let's get moving!
Perfect timing. I was just thinking of asking you again.
How about that search for an item that gives off a smell demons hate?
Will you take the job?
Thank you!
Apparently, it gives off an odor demons hate.
Reports from several adventurers have helped narrow it down,
and it seems to be on the lower levels of @6rGraham Rootze@0r.
They say demons are prowling around looking for something.
I checked the records, and judging by the location,
the lower levels of @6rGraham Rootze@0r fit.
Anyway, it seems to be somewhere around there.
That's all I know. It's a very vague search request, but...
I see. You won't...
Well, I don't have any definite information myself,
so I can't blame you...
I'll try to have the details worked out
by the next time you feel like accepting.
I have a favor to ask. Is that all right?
It might be quite a tough job.
There is usually a hint of nervousness about @7rCyrus@0r,
but this time he speaks unusually firmly.
But if the object I'm hoping to find really exists,
it might make protecting the ancient seal easier.
Will you take this job?
You received @3rAzukimaru@0r.
A bounty... on you?
@7rBeatrix@0r exchanges a glance with @7rCarmine@0r, who is also there,
and looks bewildered.
Demons putting a bounty on a human's life? It's possible...
For instance, to attract people who bear you a grudge,
a demon could put a bounty on you... Or could "bounty" mean some other kind of prize?
translations.note: The source contrasts money bounty with an unspecified prize. English spells out the wordplay so the distinction survives.

translations.en: Right. Or perhaps, if someone defeats you,
translations.note: Genuine cross-row continuation into E2720, owned by the next event slice. Shared continuation wording coordinated with the other translator.

context: Fiore describes her first delivery client; Cyrus obtains an exhausted demon-repelling staff and is reassured by his friends; a demon bounty is discussed.
decisions: Control tokens remain on their source rows and in their original sequence. Genuine sentence continuations retain row boundaries; other omitted subjects are restored from scene context. Unknown historical warrior gender stays neutral. Item names follow the shared glossary; established imported prose and provenance remain intact.
